title: Term, Renewal and Notice Periods by Tier — Contract Pricing Agreement Schedule
content:
The term, renewal and notice periods of every Contract Pricing Agreement tier are set out below. Every period is counted in calendar days or calendar months as its row states.

Columns, lowest tier to highest: **Account Price Schedule** = Corbett Account Price Schedule; **Volume Discount** = Corbett Volume Discount Agreement; **Category Contract** = Corbett Category Contract; **Net-Price** = Corbett Net-Price Contract; **Cost-Plus** = Corbett Cost-Plus Contract; **Strategic Supply** = Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement.

| Term | Account Price Schedule | Volume Discount | Category Contract | Net-Price | Cost-Plus | Strategic Supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Length of one agreement term, in months from the effective date | 12 | 12 | 12 | 24 | 36 | 36 |
| Proposal validity: calendar days after the proposal date within which the customer must sign | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 60 |
| Renewal notice: days before the expiration date at which the renewal window opens | 30 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 120 | 180 |
| Renews automatically unless either party gives notice | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Length of a renewal term, in months | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 24 |
| Early termination notice: calendar days of written notice before an early termination takes effect | 30 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 180 |

### Reading the schedule

| Question the schedule answers | Where the figure sits |
|---|---|
| How long a signed term runs | Row "Length of one agreement term" |
| How long an unsigned proposal stays open | Row "Proposal validity" |
| When the renewal window opens | Row "Renewal notice", counted back from the expiration date |
| Whether the tier renews without a new signature, and for how long | Rows "Renews automatically" and "Length of a renewal term" |
| How much written notice an early termination needs | Row "Early termination notice" |

Hypothetical example: on a tier whose renewal notice is 60 days, an agreement expiring on a given date has its renewal window open 60 days before that expiration date. (Illustrative only.)
